Down: stored or recurring P2440/P2442 codes, an active KDSS leak or lean, valley-plate coolant leakage, or significant frame rust.
Down: refusal to give the VIN or allow a PPI, a history report showing an accident, multiple owners or a branded title, or evidence of heavy towing.

evidence.rationale: The listing establishes a refresh-era 2017 GX460 at a photo-verified 174,994 miles. It has a clean exterior, stock stance, an aftermarket platform roof rack with the factory rack included, a rear receiver hitch, and no fault lamps visible in a running-engine cluster photo. Everything else is seller prose: 'clean title', 'never missed an oil change', 'tires have plenty of life'. There is no VIN, no receipts and no history report. The model-critical items are all open: secondary air injection history, KDSS fitment and condition, and frame condition on an Arkansas car. The one observed item of note is the hitch combined with the overland equipment, which makes towing and use history a direct question. At $20,000 the asking price sits above the $16,301 fair-value mid. The nearest sold comp is a 2017 Premium at 165,800 mi for $17,750, and this car's package level is unconfirmed. No specific repair is established by the listing, so known work is null; first-30-day catch-up at this mileage is a planning figure only.
